about: Which free lead-magnet tools point their visitors at which product with depth (the proprietary track in LICENSING_TRANSITION.md). The site build (platform/pages/product-offer.mjs) prints one line in each listed tool's footer naming its product. Every pairing was chosen by hand from both tools' pages: a feeder is listed only when a person using it is plausibly doing the job the product does in full. Lexical matching was tried first and rejected (docs/reports/2026-11-24-lead-magnet-funnel.md). The pitch is what the product does today; it must not claim a price, a paid tier or a result the product's page does not back. Edit by hand; product-offer.test.mjs checks every slug.

wall-framing-takeoff.pitch: lays out every stud, header and cripple in a house's walls, with a cut list and the cheapest mix of board lengths to buy

shed-designer.pitch: draws a gable shed board by board, with plans, a 3D view, a cut sheet and a shopping list

xer-schedule-check.pitch: reads a Primavera P6 XER file, recomputes the critical path and runs the DCMA 14-point assessment

ifc-quantity-takeoff.pitch: takes a bill of quantities straight from an IFC building model: counts, lengths, areas, volumes and weights

ai-bookkeeper.pitch: keeps double-entry books from your bank and card CSVs and learns from every correction you make

sales-export-to-journal.pitch: takes a sales or payout export from any of ten platforms, proves it adds up to the payout and writes the Xero or QuickBooks journal

shift-roster-builder.pitch: builds a weekly staff roster that never breaks availability, rest, hour caps or days-in-a-row rules

league-schedule-generator.pitch: builds a fair round-robin season with real dates, balanced home and away, and courts shared evenly

quick-pick-survey.pitch: ranks a list from quick pairwise picks, with a rank range per option, and combines a whole team's picks

changepoint-detector.pitch: finds when a time series changed level or volatility, with PELT segmentation and Bayesian changepoint probabilities

photo-editing.pitch: ShootFlow: safe card ingest with checksums, batch grading and Instagram reels and carousels for photographers

real-estate-agent-photo-app.pitch: Listing Lens: checks listing photos against an MLS floor spec before delivery, with a dated findings report

print-atelier.pitch: preflights a print master at its print size and compares up to five exports before you order a proof print

clothing-design-studio.pitch: designs a tee or hoodie by voice or drag, costs every piece and writes the tech pack for your manufacturer
